title: C++ Quick Reference
description: Find a word or command you have seen in a lesson. Each short note tells you what it does. Open the linked lesson for the full example.

entries.name: std::cout
entries.summary: Print values to the terminal.

entries.name: auto
entries.summary: Ask C++ to work out a variable type.

entries.name: const
entries.summary: Keep a value from being changed after it is set.

entries.name: C++20 flag
entries.summary: Choose C++20 language rules with GCC or Clang.

entries.name: Range for
entries.summary: Visit each value in a group.

entries.name: Function
entries.summary: Give a set of steps a name and call it.

entries.name: Reference
entries.summary: Give an existing value another name.

entries.name: nullptr
entries.summary: A pointer value that points at no object.

entries.name: class
entries.summary: Describe fields and actions for objects.

entries.name: const method
entries.summary: Promise to read without changing ordinary fields.

entries.name: virtual
entries.summary: Let a child class replace an action.

entries.name: override
entries.summary: Check that an action replaces a virtual parent action.

entries.name: template
entries.summary: Write a recipe that can use different types.
entries.syntax: template <typename T> T twice(T n) { return n + n; }

entries.name: std::integral
entries.summary: A C++20 concept for whole-number types.
entries.syntax: template <std::integral T> T addOne(T n) { return n + 1; }

entries.name: Lambda
entries.summary: Write a small function where it is used.

entries.name: std::vector
entries.summary: A list that can grow as items are added.

entries.name: push_back
entries.summary: Add an item at the end of a vector.

entries.name: std::map
entries.summary: Pair keys with values, such as names with scores.

entries.name: std::set
entries.summary: Keep one copy of each different value.

entries.name: std::sort
entries.summary: Put values into order between two positions.

entries.name: std::make_unique
entries.summary: Make an object with one owner that cleans it up.

entries.name: std::move
entries.summary: Allow a value or ownership to be moved.

entries.name: std::string
entries.summary: Store and work with a piece of text.

entries.name: std::optional
entries.summary: Hold a value or mark that there is no value.

entries.name: value_or
entries.summary: Read an optional or use a fallback if it is empty.
